# Synthetic RGB-D fixtures

`chess-demo` contains the full procedural chessboard; `chess-small` contains three procedural pieces. Each directory contains only `capture.npz` and its supplied `board_calibration.json`. They are synthetic renderings generated by `lidar_video.chess_data`, not iPhone recordings or model weights.

The fixtures exercise image/depth board calibration and reconstruction without reading piece identities or hidden geometry from ground truth. Test code loads them with `allow_pickle=False` through the canonical capture loader.
